story.title: Elon Musk and Sam Altman head to trial over OpenAI's for-profit future and IPO plans
story.summary: Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are heading to trial in Northern California in a case that could determine whether OpenAI is legally permitted to operate as a for-profit company. The court could also order Altman's removal as CEO, casting a shadow over OpenAI's anticipated IPO. The case marks the culmination of a years-long legal feud between the two over the company's founding mission as a nonprofit dedicated to the public good.
